description:
Look up DKIM public keys at <selector>._domainkey.<domain>. Because DKIM selectors are arbitrary and undiscoverable, you should pass the selector(s) your mail provider uses for a definitive answer; otherwise a curated list of common selectors is probed and a miss is inconclusive.

Args:
  - domain (string): the domain to check.
  - selectors (string[], optional): DKIM selectors to probe.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): output format (default 'markdown').

Returns: { any_found, probed_selectors, selectors[{selector, found, record, key_type}], findings[] }.

Examples:
  - "Does acme.com publish a DKIM key for selector 'google'?" -> dkim_check(domain="acme.com", selectors=["google"])
  - "Find any DKIM keys for acme.com" -> dkim_check(domain="acme.com")

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary (default) or 'json' for the full structured payload.

selectors.description: DKIM selectors to check (e.g. ['google']). If omitted, common provider selectors are probed — absence is then inconclusive.

name: dkim_check
title: DKIM Record Check
